metadata.description: Deterministic simulations through the production RoomStore training path; no product files modified.

simulatedPolicies.mirror-bot: The human seat calls the real decideBotCommand on projectForPlayer output, isolating identity and seat effects under identical policy.
simulatedPolicies.first-legal: The human plays playableCardIds[0] in hand order, otherwise draws; after a draw plays it if legal, otherwise passes; chooses the most present wild color and announces when reducing to one card. This is an explicit reference policy based on the simple training-test helper, with color choice and last-card announcement made explicit; it is not a model of observed user behavior. Unlike the bot, it does not prefer colored cards over an earlier playable wild.

rngWiring.shared-stream: One seeded function instance is supplied as both room.random and room.effectRandom, matching the production call topology when TRE_TTA_SEED is absent and both default to Math.random.
rngWiring.separate-streams: Separate seeded functions are supplied to rules and cosmetics to test the documented isolated-stream alternative; not the current default wiring.

metadata.permutationMethod: All 24 permutations of Pessoa/Tico/Lila/Nino are played once per seed in a deterministic shuffled order. Each identity appears six times in every physical seat.
metadata.intervalMethod: Permutation intervals use 95% normal intervals over per-seed proportions, clustering all 24 permutations by seed. Continuity intervals use per-session proportions; rare-pattern intervals use Wilson score intervals.
